text: TF-IDF multiplies term frequency by IDF; BM25 (Best Match 25, Robertson and colleagues, 1990s) adds the saturation and the length correction, and is still the standard keyword scorer: score(D, Q) = Σ t ∈ Q IDF(t) · tf · (k 1 + 1) / (tf + k 1 (1 − b + b · |D| / avgdl)) tf how often term t occurs in document D IDF(t) ln(1 + (N − df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5)), with N documents in the corpus (Lucene's form) k 1 saturation: how fast repeats stop adding (1.2 here) b length normalisation: 0 ignores length, 1 fully divides by it (0.75 here) |D|, avgdl the document's length in terms, and the corpus average (156.7 terms in SciFact) bm25s, used here, and Lucene since version 8 drop the constant factor (k 1 + 1); it multiplies every score by the same number and does not change the order.
